fixtures.source: Project-authored Google Docs native clipboard capture; no private document URL is stored.

environment.transformation: No payload edits. Three non-sensitive project-authored paragraphs and one bullet item, native Cmd+C in Google Docs; text/html and text/plain read through the clipboard interface. Private Google Docs internal-slice MIME excluded.

losses: Paragraphs, a semantic bullet list and supported inline styles survive. 11pt becomes 14.667px; browser/editor plain-text extraction need not reproduce clipboard block-separator newlines. Exact line spacing, margins, list indentation, ARIA and Docs service metadata are not persisted.
